name: eevee-material-stencil-template-lighting
purpose: Verify that EEVEE material stencil/template writers do not break deferred material lighting and that read-only stencil tests still gate shading.
passCriteria: A DITHERED deferred material that writes stencil remains as brightly lit as the same material without stencil, read-only ALWAYS remains lit, missing EQUAL stencil reads stay dark, and the forward writer path remains lit.
